name: Origins Rebirth
description:
Embark on an extraordinary Minecraft journey with Origins Rebirth (Formally Origins Reborn), where the immersive Origins Mod transforms gameplay.

🌟 Origins Rebirth supports both Java and Bedrock players in a modless environment tailored for interactive community gameplay. Key features include: 🌟

🌌 15+ Unique Origins

🦄 Custom Mobs

🏡 Active Towny

🍻 Overhauled Brewing

🗺️ New Worldgen

🔗 Hand-Tailored Plugins

💰 Player-Driven Economy

🔄 Weekly Updates

📱 Mobile/Console Friendly GUIs

🎯 Custom Bounty System

🔥 Join the biggest modless Origins server today and begin your journey! 🌍
